en.bdb: The Creator is inaccessible for the creation

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਕਵਾਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਅਥਾਹ ਵਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh dhareeaau kavaau vich at asagaeh athaeh vaha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In His will lakhs of deep and unfathomable rivers (of life) go on flowing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਫੇਰ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: aadh na a(n)t bia(n)t hai agam agochar fer fira(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Beginning and end of those life currents cannot be understood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: alakh apaar vakhaaneeaai paaraavaar na paar laha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: They are infinite, inaccessible and imperceptible but still all move in the Lord, the great. They cannot know the extent of that imperceptible and boundless Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਲਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਗਮ ਰੰਗ ਰਵੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lahar tara(n)g nisa(n)g lakh saagar sa(n)gam ra(n)g rava(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Rivers having myriad's of waves meeting the ocean becomes one with it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਤੁਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: ratan padhaarath lakh lakh mul amul na tul tula(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In that ocean are lakhs of invaluable jewel materials, which in fact are beyond all costing.
I am sacrifice unto that Creator Lord.
